text: Added LatentRoundtripMatrixSuite. It constructs separable temporal x spatial fixtures for provided temporal basis, DCT, and Haar; roundtrips each through LatentEncoder.toArchive/fromArchive; materializes the same data through shared-basis spatial archives; verifies full reconstruction, ordered time/sample selections, coefficient decode via coefTime.transpose, archive kind, and temporal/spatial agreement. Verification passed: sbt latentJVM/test latentJS/test (49 tests each platform).
